selected_evidence.requirement: SSH allowed from anywhere on node1
selected_evidence.summary: ufw status shows 22/tcp ALLOW IN Anywhere both before and after node1 restart; node3->node1:22 nc test succeeds.
ufw rule '9000/tcp ALLOW IN 10.100.56.11' present; nc from node2 to node1:9000 succeeds before restart, after node1's restart, and after node2's own restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: TCP 9000 rejected from node3 and everywhere else
selected_evidence.summary: ufw rules reject 9000/tcp from 10.100.56.12 and from Anywhere; nc from node3 to node1:9000 returns 'Connection refused' before restart, after node1's restart, and after node3's own restart.
systemctl is-enabled/is-active ufw show enabled+active; ufw status verbose after node1 reboot shows identical ruleset to pre-reboot baseline.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart with changed boot identity and recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 242af11e captured; reboot issued; connection timed out mid-reboot; new boot_id 8b4b99f6 confirms restart; post-restart ufw ruleset intact and firewall behavior (allow node2 / reject node3) re-verified with live nc tests.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart with changed boot identity and recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 37344ae4 captured; reboot issued; connection timed out mid-reboot; new boot_id b7defb7a confirms restart; post-restart node2 successfully reconnects to node1:9000 confirming service/network recovery.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart with changed boot identity and recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 4d70780a captured; reboot issued; connection timed out mid-reboot; new boot_id 6bf9e421 confirms restart; post-restart node3 remains rejected on 9000 and SSH still reachable, confirming firewall policy and network recovery.
